title: Add multiplication
summary: Multiplication returns the product of two safe integers.
problemStatement: The example project needs this change: Add multiplication.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Multiplication returns the exact product for safe results, including multiply(2, 3) = 6 and multiply(-2, 3) = -6.
Multiplication raises RangeError for fractional, non-finite or unsafe integer inputs.
